known_risks: Direct first-submit can still pay cold startup or external wait if same-route prewarm has not completed; latest auth HMAC key cache reduced repeated auth_context_cookie signing to 0.4-0.5ms, but the first latest sample still had 2551ms wall time for 315.0ms route compute.
Node/Playwright request DNS intermittently returned ENOTFOUND for sales.cyanlog.icu while curl and Chrome verified the alias; keep external resolver failures classified separately from app errors.
Feishu success path requires FEISHU_APP_ID and FEISHU_APP_SECRET in Production.

/configs first-load bundle is improved from the earlier 281kB and 166kB samples to 159kB after lazy-loading edit dialogs, and /admin/org is improved from 245kB to 107kB after lazy-loading the organization workbench. Keep shared chunks and heavier adjacent routes under bundle watch.
Historical design archive product-truth/03-design-truth/archived/Cyanlog-UI-Kit-source.html is about 9.5MB and remains tracked as reference material; do not delete without replacing the asset policy.
External Supabase/GitHub network waits can still create intermittent long latency and need explicit timing/error classification.
Supabase remote db lint failed before linting due temporary role SASL auth/circuit breaker; migration application was verified by migration list and live login headers.

Build has known dependency warnings: Sentry/OpenTelemetry dynamic require and webpack cache big string serialization. The previous Vercel sharp ignored build scripts warning was cleared by approving sharp in pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies. The local SWC fallback warning was cleared by restoring the missing generated @next/swc-darwin-arm64 package/link state.
Legacy archived rule rows remain in stats for compatibility.

Org-admin route latency can still vary with auth/default-org resolution and Supabase network waits; route responses now expose X-Org-Payload-Source and X-Org-Timing to classify auth, RPC payload, fallback payload and total time.

API schema migration is still staged by domain, but direct unguarded req.json()/request.json() and req.formData()/request.formData() scans in app/api are now empty. Remaining debt is response envelope/code consistency and route-by-route domain schemas, not raw JSON/formData parse failure.
Production app/components/lib no longer has direct any matches in the D09 search; test and mock files still use any and need a separate test typing cleanup if desired.
